messages.author: niaj
messages.content:
v2 field changes (from v1 → v2):
  • `name`        → `event_name`
  • `user_id`     → `actor_id`
  • `data`        → `attributes`
  • `timestamp`   → `recorded_at`  (int milliseconds, NOT float seconds)
  • `schema_version`: integer 2 (was string "1")
Migration guide in the wiki under /data-platform/v2-migration.

**FINAL v2 analytics event spec (canonical, use this):**
```python
{
    "event_name":     str,   # was 'name'
    "actor_id":       str,   # was 'user_id'  — NOTE: NOT 'author_id'
    "attributes":     dict,  # was 'data'
    "recorded_at":    int,   # milliseconds since epoch (int, NOT float)
    "schema_version": 2,     # integer 2, NOT string '2'
}
```
